name: Gaspé Current
scope: OSW southern lower-estuary offshore approach near Pointe-des-Monts latitude, along the Gaspe Peninsula and toward a gate north of the Magdalen Islands. Excludes upstream river/estuary length, episodic north-shore feeder, Anticosti Gyre circuit, Chaleur Bay recirculation and Cabot Strait/Scotian downstream routes. No full connected-system length.
layer: Upper-layer coastal jet naming context; typical regional summary describes approximately upper 40 m. No depth-specific velocity core or uniform transverse footprint reconstructed.
time_convention: Regional reference informed by February 2022 thesis introduction and a 2024 coastal circulation-model description. Not a dated observed path, annual mean axis or continuous trajectory through all meanders and detachments.
source_locator: Printed page 14 / PDF page 30, chapter 2.2 Introduction: lower-estuary origin near Pointe-des-Monts and extension toward Magdalen Islands; printed page 5 / PDF page 21 describes eastward peninsula coastal jet and episodic feeder/Anticosti influence.
source_citation: Leclercq, Théau (2022), Observations des remontées et des plongées des eaux en bordure du courant de Gaspé, master's thesis in oceanography, UQAR-ISMER, February 2022.

supporting_sources.citation: Paquin et al. (2024), A new high-resolution Coastal Ice-Ocean Prediction System for the East Coast of Canada, Ocean Dynamics 74, 799-826, doi:10.1007/s10236-024-01634-7.
supporting_sources.locator: Section 2, spectral-nudging discussion: buoyancy-driven south-shore current, detachment and Anticosti recirculation; fine current meanders are not deterministically constrained.
supporting_sources.role: Continuity caveat; source used only for named-flow/detachment context, not digitized numerical-model route.

coordinate_selection: Every offshore vertex and approach gate is OSW-selected. Thesis supplies named origin/region/extension but not these coordinates, precise current endpoints or a measured length. Alternative lower-estuary and Magdalen approach gates test regional convention. No source track or front digitized. Reported 10-20 km width range is separate regional context, not a route buffer. Approximate context markers are not coast outlines or clearance evidence.

alternative_routes.interpretation: OSW shortened approach gates along the same regional corridor; not observed seasonal contraction.

scenario_rule: Two selected regional approach-gate conventions crossed with longitude and independent endpoint latitude offsets -0.05/0/+0.05 degrees: 54 editorial scenarios, not seasonal variation, velocity-front width or measured endpoint uncertainty.
